text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket delivered splendid results 
in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaaaan! Let me hide for just a 
bit, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm playing hide-and-seek with Taishin and 
Hayahide, and this is a battle I 
absolutely, positively cannot loseee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!! You should always give 
it your all in everything you do on a 
daily basis!! Because that's the way BNW 
should be!!

Putting aside during races and training, I 
don't recall them constantly competing 
over every little thing in their daily 
lives.

Seeing Winning Ticket proudly puff out her 
chest, I asked her for more details—
A few minutes earlier—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide!! Taishin!! Let's raccccccccce!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
As rivals, we gotta be sparking sparks and 
clashing head-on anytime, anywhereee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What's with you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Most likely, she was inspired by a 
manga.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Competing with each other, lifting each 
other up— a passionate friendship that 
turns them into soulmates before they even 
realize it...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's keep pushing each 
other to new heights, anytime, anywhere, 
with everything we've got!!!

And so, with Narita Taishin losing at 
rock-paper-scissors and being made "it," a 
game of hide-and-seek apparently began.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Hayahide's already been captured!! So I 
gotta do my best!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if the demon shows up, I'm 
counting on you!! Trainer-san!!

"—And just as Winning Ticket slid behind 
the desk..."
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do you need a ticket?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. Let me take a short 
break.

Looking around the trainer's office, 
Narita Taishin casually picked up a 
booklet that was lying on the desk.

This is Winning Ticket's race rotation 
from last year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Last year's rotation, huh? The Osaka Hai, 
the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Was that back when Ticket wasn't doing so 
well?

Nodding slightly at Biwa Hayahide's words, 
Narita Taishin muttered under her breath.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I thought you should just 
quit. Especially around the time of the 
Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, you came back, so it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I know you were actually quite 
concerned about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Even Hayahide said she was 'longing 
for a fierce battle.'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's the truth. Racing against you 
all is the best training I could ever ask 
for.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: At least act a little shy...

While watching their back-and-forth 
fondly, my heart still burns hot whenever 
I remember that fierce battle.

Though they drifted apart and clashed at 
times, they always kept a watchful eye on 
Winning Ticket through it all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really... It's not like I meddled 
around like Hayahide does, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If we're going there, I was just worried 
too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The reason she got back on her feet is 
because of the inherent resilience and 
strength Ticket has always possessed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOUUUU!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, sooooo glad I came to the academy 
and met you twooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Knew you'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank y—huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Strategy success~. My win. Well then, 
hide-and-seek is over."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah?! A win?! Huh?! What?! Wait, 
really?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, honestly... you're so stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave as well. 
I must return the book I borrowed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: They're gone...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Ehehehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was super happy about what the two of 
you were saying--!! Even though I only 
understood like half of it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was only able to run such an 
'awesome race' because the two of you were 
there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I'm so glad I came to Tracen 
Academy, and I'm so glad I got to meet the 
two of you~~!!

Over these three years, Narita Taishin and 
Biwa Hayahide had a massive influence on 
Winning Ticket.

They will surely remain by Winning 
Ticket's side, continuing to inspire and 
influence her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"And besides, and besides! I got to meet 
the absolute best Trainer, too!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, let's keep giving it our all 
together, Trainer!"

“—On a tranquil afternoon, my days of 
walking alongside Winning Ticket began 
once more.”
